_comment: WORKED EXAMPLE OF A REJECTED SUBMISSION — do not merge this record. This is the Alitheon AI Breakthrough entry exactly as received from mc-content on 2026-08-21. The award is real and the facts check out; the entry is rejected because of who granted it, not whether it happened. Tech Breakthrough runs AI/IoT/FinTech/MedTech/BioTech/Data Breakthrough in parallel as a wide lattice of 'X of the Year' slots filled from solicited nominations, with no published judging panel or methodology, so it cannot fill in awarderProfile. Kept in the repo as the schema contract AND as the regression case for the provenance gate. Run: node scripts/promote-recognition.mjs --in scripts/data/recognition-handoff.rejected-example.json  (expect a non-zero exit and a provenance failure). See docs/plans/2026-08-21-cohort-recognition-promoter.md.
